born.why: This code prioritizes survival by eating when starving, learning about new fruits via tasting when safe, avoiding known poisonous species, and carrying food to build a pantry buffer for future uncertainty.
The code prioritizes survival by eating when starving, avoiding fruits with similar traits to previously poisoned ones, and cautiously tasting novel fruits that appear safe based on historical data.
The code prioritizes survival by eating unknown fruits when starving, tastes unknown fruits to learn their safety when well-fed, avoids known poisons, and carries known safe or targeted fruits home.
The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starving, leveraging past data to distinguish safe from risky fruits by species key, and only tasting unknowns when hunger warrants the risk.
Prioritizes survival by eating when starving, uses memory to avoid poisonous fruits identified in the past, and prefers carrying or tasting safe species, otherwise relying on innate instinct.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding known poisonous fruits (those that increased hunger in the past), exploits safe foods by carrying them home for efficiency, and uses instinct as a fallback when data is lacking.
